cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The team trip is two hundred short. Your prize is two hundred. Do I record it as your winnings or the team's travel fund?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can take the cheaper coach and I can keep some.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That saves forty. You'll still need to choose what happens to the remaining hundred and sixty; please don't record a saving as a payment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone could put in ten pounds instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put that beside 'I keep the prize'. Read the two options to them: your two hundred, or their contributions. Please don't call the second one free.

reason: Ground the actual shortfall and use B's alternative funding source to expose which reward is being kept and who pays.
